Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 57568 of 2022
Applicant :- Rukumpal @ Rinku

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ehtesham Afsar Khan,Narendra Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Anurag Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Prem Shankar Mishra Advocate
holding brief of Sri Narendra Singh, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Jhamman Ram,
learned Aga for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 107
of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 Ipc, Police Station Kishni, District Mainpuri,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.

According to the FIR, applicant alongwith co-accused Rishi stated to the informant that his relatives co-accused Saurabh Singh and Surendra wants to sale their two vehicles and in this regard, he received total Rs. Eighteen lacs and thirty thousand from the informant and thereafter, it revealed to the informant that there is loan over both the vehicles and also that the finance clearance receipt which was provided by the accused person to him was also forged.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and he never received any money from the informant and actually the contract with regard to the alleged vehicle was executed between the co-accused Saurabh Singh and Rukumpal @ Rinku vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120815134/
1 informant on 1.10.2022 and this agreement has been annexed as annexure-8 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.

sentences.text: He further submitted that from the perusal of the receipt also it appears that the money was received by Saurabh Singh which has been annexed as annexure-9 to the affidavit and applicant has been made accused in the present matter only because he is distinct relative of Saurabh Singh.

He further submitted that similarly placed co-accused Rishi has already been enlarged on bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 5.1.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail application No. 57690 of 2022.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 6.11.2022, therefore, he may be released on bail.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that similarly placed co-accused Rishi has already been released on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 5.1.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 57690 of 2022.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 57690 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

Although there is allegation against the applicant and co-accused Rishi that they received a huge amount of more than Rs. Eighteen lacs from the informant with regard to two vehicles but from the perusal of the annexure-8 to the affidavit it appears that an agreement with regard to the alleged vehicle was executed between informant and owner of the vehicle and admittedly applicant is not the the owner of the alleged vehicle.

Further, similarly placed co-accused Rishi has already been enlarged on bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 5.1.2023 passed by Crl.
Misc. 57690 of 2022, therefore, considering this fact and the fact that applicant is in jail since 6.11.2022, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Rukumpal @ Rinku be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
